This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the player must locate mossy stone bricks in the environment. It is easily verifiable (the player needs to have mossy_stone_bricks visible in their field of view or be near them), doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, and can be set up in an interesting scene with a structure containing mossy stone bricks that the player must navigate to find. Since we're selecting exactly 1 task, there are no dependency edges needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the stone brick ruins structure and face the mossy stone bricks on its exterior walls. Target is set to [6, 1, 6] (the approximate center of the structure where mossy bricks are placed on walls at eye level). max_distance=8 allows the player to see the mossy bricks from a reasonable viewing distance without requiring them to be right on top of the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure rather than facing away.

scene_description: A small stone brick ruins structure (5x5 footprint, 3 blocks tall) located 4-8 blocks from spawn in the +X/+Z direction. The structure has walls of regular stone bricks with several mossy stone bricks placed at eye level on exterior walls (positions ~4,1,6 / ~4,2,6 / ~8,1,6 / ~8,2,6 / ~6,1,8 / ~6,2,8) and on the floor inside (~5,0,5 / ~6,0,6 / ~7,0,7). A 2-block doorway at ~6,1-2,4 allows entry. The player must navigate toward the structure and identify the mossy stone bricks.
task_text: Find the mossy stone bricks in the nearby stone ruins structure.
design_notes: Structure placed at ~4-8 in both X and Z from spawn. Mossy stone bricks placed on exterior walls at y=1 and y=2 (eye level) for visibility from outside. Additional mossy bricks on the floor inside for discovery upon entry. Doorway faces the player spawn direction (-Z side at ~6,1-2,4). The grass_block floor and air clearing ensure clean navigation.
